recommended.title: Progress persistence
recommended.acceptance: Progress rows are scoped to a profile id rather than a user id and keyed by (profileId, contentId) so a repeated write upserts idempotently, with read and write authorized against the active profile; two devices writing the same title are resolved by a server-issued writer epoch rather than by client timestamps or by a monotonically-increasing-position rule, because client clocks are unreliable and a monotonic rule wrongly refuses a legitimate rewind; and writes go directly to PostgreSQL, with no Redis write-behind introduced until a PostgreSQL problem has actually been measured

recommended.title: Watchlist persistence
recommended.acceptance: Typed add, remove, and list APIs with authorization
